Entries.Text: 9 cases were generated by varying Depth [m] (18, 20, 22); qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] (5, 7.5, 10), every other input held at the model's value. 9 were analysed with the internal FEM. Responses are read in 'SLS: 1.0DL+1.0LL'; the horizontal and vertical base forces are the sums over the supports of one end.
9 of 9 cases (100%) satisfy δ in SLS: 1.0DL+1.0LL ≤ span / 250 and uplift ≤ 0 mm.

Ranges 228 … 372 mm. Most sensitive to qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] (swing 34.3%, elasticity 0.51 — +1% of qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] gives +0.51% of the response); it rises almost linearly as qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] increases. Next: Depth [m] (swing 14.1%, elasticity -0.71 — +1% of Depth [m] gives -0.71% of the response).

Entries.Key: vcf/summary/03 Base horizontal force H (one end)
Entries.Text: Ranges 16,231 … 19,357 kN. Most sensitive to qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] (swing 16.4%, elasticity 0.25 — +1% of qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] gives +0.25% of the response); it rises almost linearly as qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] increases. It does not depend on Depth [m] (swing below 0.5%).

Entries.Key: vcf/summary/04 Total cost of the system
Entries.Text: Ranges 7,248,380 … 8,054,650 SGD. Most sensitive to Depth [m] (swing 10.5%, elasticity 0.53 — +1% of Depth [m] gives +0.53% of the response); it rises almost linearly as Depth [m] increases. It does not depend on qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] (swing below 0.5%).

The cheapest passing case is case 1 (Depth [m] 18, qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] 5): SGD 7,248,380, δ 266.4 mm against 400.0 mm (δ / limit 0.67), H 16,231 kN at one end. It keeps more than a quarter of the deflection limit in reserve, so a lighter system outside the ranges studied may still pass.

Trends are main effects: each curve averages over the other parameters, so a strong interaction (see the interaction plot) can hide behind a flat mean. Results hold within the ranges studied; every case is analysed with the app's internal FEM and the Analysis Options of the model.
Max deflection δ is governed by qz LL_ABOVE [kPa]: it rises by 34% of its mean over the range, 2.4× the effect of Depth [m].
Base horizontal force H (one end) is governed by qz LL_ABOVE [kPa]: it rises by 16% of its mean over the range.
Total cost of the system is governed by Depth [m]: it rises by 11% of its mean over the range.
Recommended starting point: case 1 (Depth [m] 18, qz LL_ABOVE [kPa] 5), SGD 7,248,380.
